title: Implicit enumeration program
statement: The program has one work tape, two deciders, and the states of the implicit enumeration machine. Its ordinary machine is the specified Boolean one-tape machine; at state `ask` it calls decider 0 on the whole virtual input with register 0 as its argument, proceeding to `bit` on a positive answer and `done` on a negative answer. At state `bit` it calls decider 1 in the same mode with the same register argument, proceeding to `emitT` on a positive answer and `emitF` on a negative answer; in every other state it has no call.
hypotheses_covered: State set inherited from the supplied implicit enumeration machine
Call at ask uses decider 0, whole-input mode, argument register 0, and successors bit/done
Call at bit uses decider 1, whole-input mode, argument register 0, and successors emitT/emitF
All other states have no call
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definitions of the ordinary machine's increment actions and of the virtual-input encoding.
